rootCauseHypothesis:
The page under test did not expose the expected anchor element a[href="/onboarding/p2p"] before the timeout, likely because the onboarding UI is not rendering correctly on the host. Common hosting-side causes include a broken deployment, JS hydration/render failure, slow or blocked asset/API loading, auth/feature-flag conditions that suppress the link, or a route/path change that removed or renamed the expected link. Underlying error: TimeoutError: Locator.click: Timeout 10000ms exceeded.
Call log:
  - waiting for locator("a[href=\"/onboarding/p2p\"]")

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Ensure the onboarding page renders a clickable anchor with href='/onboarding/p2p' within 10 seconds, or update the route/link target if it changed. Check for broken client-side rendering/hydration, auth/feature-flag gating, A/B tests, or redirects that prevent the link from appearing. If the page is dynamically loaded, reduce blocking requests and avoid hiding the link behind late-loading scripts; if the path changed, restore the old route or provide a backward-compatible link.
